Gemma 4 E4B
Mural\'s recommended model: the best conversation quality, and it hears your voice. Needs a phone with 12 GB of memory.
Gemma 4 E2B
Lighter and faster than Gemma 4 E4B, and it hears your voice. Needs a phone with 8 GB of memory.
Qwen2.5 1.5B
The smallest curated model. Typed conversations only: it cannot hear your voice. Needs a phone with 6 GB of memory.
Gemini Nano (System AICore)
Your phone\'s own system model: nothing to download and nothing to delete. Pick it and converse on this phone right away.
